usage.primary: #062F4F for titles, navigation active state, and primary measures
usage.positive: #7CBB00 for profit-positive or completed status only

controls.slicers: compact dropdown/tile controls in the reserved header band
controls.navigation: horizontal below title, primary-color active state, neutral inactive state

accessibility: Do not use color as the only status signal
Maintain at least 4.5:1 body-text contrast and 3:1 mark contrast
Set tab order to match visual reading order
constraint: Do not replace or invent a different theme; implementation may add only compatible Power BI defaults around this palette.
